data.title: Crystal Palace vs Nottingham Forest Lineups, Prediction, Best Bets & Odds
data.content:
Crystal Palace are expected to line up in a 3-4-3 formation featuring Dean Henderson and Eddie Nketiah, though Axel Disasi is suspended. Nottingham Forest are projected to play a 3-4-2-1 formation with Matz Sels, Morgan Gibbs-White, and Liam Delap.

### Disclaimer [...] Forest travel well. Six of their seven Premier League wins in 2026 have come on the road, including last month's impressive win at Aston Villa. Glasner's side create chances and win aerial duels, with Morgan Gibbs-White operating behind Liam Delap. The catch is finishing — Forest don't convert enough of what they create.

data.title: Crystal Palace v Nottingham Forest: Prediction, team news, lineups and odds
data.content:
BBC Radio 5 Sports Extra 2 will provide full match commentary.

## Crystal Palace team news

Axel Disasi is still suspended and Takehiro Tomiyasu has been ruled out through injury, so Honest Ahanor is set to play alongside Chris Richards and Jaydee Canvot in the back three.

Dean Henderson and Jean-Philippe Mateta are both close to making a return, but this game will come a little bit too soon for them. [...] In more positive injury news, Anan Khalaili is available despite picking up a minor injury on international duty and Ismaila Sarr has been passed fit to start.

## Nottingham Forest team news

Nikola Milenkovic returned to training during the international break following a previous hamstring injury and played in a behind-closed-doors friendly against Swansea.

But the centre-back will not make the trip to Selhurst Park after sustaining bone bruising during a collision in training. [...] Glasner revealed that Igor Jesus is likely to be out of action for a few weeks with a calf injury, while defender Neco Williams is also a doubt through illness.

Nicolo Savana is still sidelined after undergoing surgery on an knee injury back in March.

## Crystal Palace v Nottingham Forest odds

After losses in their first two Premier League home games, Crystal Palace are 7/4 to get the win and put one over their former boss.
